name: Homokmégy (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Homokmégy (a blue shield with two white storks, a snake and a green base) above the name HOMOKMÉGY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
